title: Frontier exploration B: SAT and learning null results
question: Frontier B (ECDLP-29), NULL at toy sizes: (F-B1) SAT encoding of [k]P = Q (double-and-add, mod-p multiplier circuits, Glucose4) solves n = 5..10-bit instances but conflicts scale ~ r^1.2 (worse than brute force r^1.0 and rho r^0.5), with a key-independent floor from inverting modular multiplication; (F-B2) logistic regression and 1-hidden-layer MLP on coordinate features predict no bit/residue of k beyond the pre-registered 4-sigma rule (0/174 tests; identity and x-parity positive controls fire 165/174 and 12/12; detection floor ~0.045-0.12 advantage); (F-B3) learn-then-decode (HNP/list decoding) would need an eps-advantage oracle that F-B2 does not find. 11 further ideas killed by argument (lattice/CVP circular, batching, advice).
